$comment: DST fall-back edge case, America/Los_Angeles 2025-11-02 (02:00 PDT -> 01:00 PST). Timestamps are UTC per firmware contract. Session starts 23:00 PDT Nov 1 (06:00 UTC) and runs to 03:00 PST Nov 2 (11:00 UTC). The 08:30 UTC and 09:30 UTC blocks are BOTH 01:30 local wall-clock (first pass PDT, repeat pass PST) — the repeated hour. All blocks must land in one session with night_of = 2025-11-01 (2025-11-01T07:00:00.000Z).
